求极限

lim⁡n→∞(1n2+1+1n2+2+⋯+1n2+n).\lim_{n\to\infty}\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{n^{2}+1}}+\frac{1}{\sqrt{n^{2}+2}}+\cdots+\frac{1}{\sqrt{n^{2}+n}}\right).n→∞lim​(n2+1​1​+n2+2​1​+⋯+n2+n​1​).
hintHtml: 和式共有 nnn 项，每一项都介于 1n2+n\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{n^{2}+n}}n2+n​1​ 与 1n2+1\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{n^{2}+1}}n2+1​1​ 之间，先给整个和式找上下界。
solutionHtml:
记

an=∑k=1n1n2+k.a_n=\sum_{k=1}^{n}\frac{1}{\sqrt{n^{2}+k}}.an​=k=1∑n​n2+k​1​.

对每个 k=1,2,…,nk=1,2,\dots,nk=1,2,…,n，有 n2+1≤n2+k≤n2+nn^{2}+1\le n^{2}+k\le n^{2}+nn2+1≤n2+k≤n2+n，因此

1n2+n≤1n2+k≤1n2+1.\frac{1}{\sqrt{n^{2}+n}}\le \frac{1}{\sqrt{n^{2}+k}}\le \frac{1}{\sqrt{n^{2}+1}}.n2+n​1​≤n2+k​1​≤n2+1​1​.

和式共 nnn 项，逐项放缩得

nn2+n≤an≤nn2+1.\frac{n}{\sqrt{n^{2}+n}}\le a_n\le \frac{n}{\sqrt{n^{2}+1}}.n2+n​n​≤an​≤n2+1​n​.

两端都趋于 111。以左端为例，

nn2+n−1=n−n2+nn2+n=−nn2+n(n+n2+n),\frac{n}{\sqrt{n^{2}+n}}-1 =\frac{n-\sqrt{n^{2}+n}}{\sqrt{n^{2}+n}} =\frac{-n}{\sqrt{n^{2}+n}\left(n+\sqrt{n^{2}+n}\right)},n2+n​n​−1=n2+n​n−n2+n​​=n2+n​(n+n2+n​)−n​,

所以

∣nn2+n−1∣=nn2+n(n+n2+n)≤nn⋅2n=12n→0.\left|\frac{n}{\sqrt{n^{2}+n}}-1\right| =\frac{n}{\sqrt{n^{2}+n}\left(n+\sqrt{n^{2}+n}\right)} \le \frac{n}{n\cdot 2n} =\frac{1}{2n}\to 0.​n2+n​n​−1​=n2+n​(n+n2+n​)n​≤n⋅2nn​=2n1​→0.

同理，由 n2+1−n=1n2+1+n\sqrt{n^{2}+1}-n=\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{n^{2}+1}+n}n2+1​−n=n2+1​+n1​ 得

∣nn2+1−1∣=1n2+1(n+n2+1)≤1n⋅2n=12n2→0.\left|\frac{n}{\sqrt{n^{2}+1}}-1\right| =\frac{1}{\sqrt{n^{2}+1}\left(n+\sqrt{n^{2}+1}\right)} \le \frac{1}{n\cdot 2n} =\frac{1}{2n^{2}}\to 0.​n2+1​n​−1​=n2+1​(n+n2+1​)1​≤n⋅2n1​=2n21​→0.

故上下界都趋于 111，由夹逼准则

lim⁡n→∞an=1.\lim_{n\to\infty}a_n=1.n→∞lim​an​=1.
mistakesHtml: 常见错误是「一共有 nnn 项，每项趋于 000，所以和趋于 000」——项数随 nnn 变化时不能这样做，∞⋅0\infty\cdot 0∞⋅0 型必须整体估计。另一个错误是把上界写成 nn2+1\dfrac{n}{\sqrt{n^{2}+1}}n2+1​n​ 后直接说它等于 111，应当说明它与 111 的差是 O ⁣(1n)O\!\left(\dfrac{1}{n}\right)O(n1​)，或者用夹逼写清楚。
answerHtml: 111
